Asia is a wild wild place. There was a nightclub on Okinawa during the late 80's that was very modern and played typical club music but on one entire wall from floor to ceiling was a video being played inside the club from the infamous "Faces of Death" collection. There is a Wikipedia article (no pictures, obviously) about this video collection. Amidst the club goers and jovial atmosphere was morbid footage of people being eaten by crocodiles, people being decapitated, electrocution footage, footage of a group of people sitting around a table with a monkey strapped in and a hammer was used on the monkey and then the participants would then eat the monkey's brain. The craziest footage of people (or animals) dying ever caught on video.
The stark contrast of the typical night club environment (with everyone dressed in nice attire) and the GROSSEST video footage (back when VHS tapes would make the rounds from place to place) was so eerie and crazy its hard to imagine such a thing occurred. I was in that club and I saw it with my own eyes. Like I said, Asia is a very very wild place. 🤮🤮🤮

The beheading thing resonated with me. In 2004 when I was under statutory consultation of redundancy, I had a VERY vivid dream of being literally beheaded, Japanese POW style. I suddenly found myself kneeling down on a dusty floor, blindfolded but able to see a little out of the bottom of the blind fold and feeling the hot sun on my back and neck, hands tied behind my back. I then felt a nudge to my back and my head was forced down and then I felt a heavy whack to the back of my neck and for a brief instance, the flesh of the right hand side corner of my neck being sliced through, and then a gush of wetness pouring down my chest. I then woke up with a start and for the whole day, I had a very bruised feeling neck. It was incredibly realistic, though strangely I didn't feel scared, just confused. I just assumed it was related to the impending redundancy. 
A few years later I had another near death experience when I collapsed in a restaurant at a ski resort.  Whilst I was unconscious I had a very vivid vision of being on a ledge above a black pit, trying to pull myself up and the intense feeling that if I didn't make it onto the ledge, that I would die. Then I came round and the whole restaurant was stood around me watching.
